description: Get the link to a free live team-building game for a meeting, offsite or video call: the host shows a join code on a screen; everyone answers 20 quick questions on their phone (about 3 minutes) and guesses who is who; then the team map is revealed together, with kind awards and questions to talk about. No sign-up. Good as an icebreaker or a team-building activity.
